title_uz: Atrof-muhit muhandisi qanday muammolarni hal qiladi?
title_en: What problems do environmental engineers solve?
description_uz: Havo, suv va tuproqni asrash uchun muhandislar qanday yechimlar yaratishini 4 savolda tekshiring.
description_en: Explore how engineers protect air, water and soil with 4 questions.

questions.question_uz: Atrof-muhit muhandisligining asosiy maqsadi nima?
questions.question_en: What is the main aim of environmental engineering?
options_uz: Atrof-muhit va aholi salomatligini muhofaza qilish
options_en: Increasing vehicle speeds
Updating the appearance of buildings
Protecting the environment and public health
Planning production volumes
questions.explanation_uz: Bu soha ifloslanish va chiqindilar bilan bog‘liq muammolarga yechim yaratadi. Maqsad — atrof-muhit sifatini va inson salomatligini yaxshilash.
questions.explanation_en: The field develops solutions to pollution and waste problems. Its aim is to improve environmental quality and human health.

evidence.quote: Atrof-muhit muhandisligi aholi salomatligini muhofaza qilish va atrof-muhit sifatini yaxshilashda
evidence.learning_objective: Identify the purpose of environmental engineering.

questions.question_uz: Zavod oqova suvini xavfsiz chiqarishni rejalashtirmoqda. Qaysi loyiha shu muammoga bevosita mos keladi?
questions.question_en: A factory plans to discharge its wastewater safely. Which project directly addresses this problem?
options_en: Designing a wastewater treatment system
Designing a system to measure smoke composition
Designing a solid waste sorting area
Planning the cleanup of contaminated soil
questions.explanation_uz: Oqova suvlarni tozalash va ularning xavfsiz chiqarilishini nazorat qilish atrof-muhit muhandisligining vazifalaridan biridir.
questions.explanation_en: Treating wastewater and controlling its safe disposal are responsibilities of environmental engineering.

evidence.quote: Oqova suvlar – oqova suvlarni tozalash va xavfsiz utilizatsiya nazorati.
evidence.learning_objective: Match wastewater treatment to an environmental problem.

questions.question_uz: Yangi tozalash tizimini qurishdan oldin uning ishini baholashda maqolada qaysi vositalar tavsiya etilgan?
questions.question_en: Which tools does the article describe for assessing a treatment system before it is built?
options_uz: Uskuna narxlari va yetkazib berish sanalari
options_en: Construction timelines and staffing schedules
Equipment prices and delivery dates
Product advertisements and customer surveys
Mathematical modelling and computer analysis
questions.explanation_uz: Matematik modellar va kompyuter tahlili zarur tizimlarni baholash hamda loyihalashga yordam beradi.
questions.explanation_en: Mathematical models and computer analysis help engineers assess and design the required systems.

evidence.quote: Bunday vazifalar uchun zarur bo'lgan tizimlarni baholash va loyihalash uchun matematik modellashtirish va kompyuter tahlili keng qo'llaniladi.
evidence.learning_objective: Recognise modelling as a design and assessment tool.

questions.question_uz: Maqolaga ko‘ra, allaqachon tarqalgan ifloslanishni o‘rganishda qaysi ish muhim?
questions.question_en: According to the article, which task matters when investigating pollution that has already been released?
options_uz: Kelgusi yillardagi ichimlik suviga talabni hisoblash
Yangi suv tarmog‘i uchun quvur diametrlarini tanlash
Yomg‘ir suvi zaxirasi uchun idish sig‘imini rejalash
options_en: Forecasting demand for drinking water in future years
Detecting the pollution and tracing its source
Selecting pipe diameters for a new water network
Planning tank capacity for a rainwater reserve
questions.explanation_uz: Muhandislar mavjud ifloslanishni ham aniqlaydi va uning manbasini izlaydi. Keyin korxonalar bilan uning tarqalishini kamaytirish ustida ishlaydi.
questions.explanation_en: Engineers also detect existing pollution and trace its source. They then work with businesses to reduce its release.

evidence.quote: allaqachon chiqarilgan ifloslantiruvchi moddalarni aniqlaydi va ularni manbaga qaytaradi.
evidence.learning_objective: Recognise that environmental work also addresses existing pollution.

source_title: Yashil inshootlar kelajagi: Atrof-muhit muhandisligi arxitekturani qanday o'zgartirmoqda?
description_uz: Barqaror bino, hamkorlik, passiv dizayn va suvni tejash haqida 4 savol.
description_en: Answer 4 questions on sustainable buildings, collaboration, passive design and saving water.

questions.question_uz: Barqaror arxitektura binoning atrof-muhitga ta’sirini qaysi davrda kamaytirishga intiladi?
questions.question_en: Over what period does sustainable architecture aim to reduce a building’s environmental impact?
options_en: While the construction site is being prepared
Throughout the building’s entire life cycle
On the day the building opens
While the building’s appearance is being chosen
questions.explanation_uz: Barqaror arxitektura loyihalash, qurilish va foydalanishni birgalikda hisobga oladi. Maqsad binoning butun hayoti davomida ta’sirni kamaytirishdir.
questions.explanation_en: Sustainable architecture considers design, construction and use together. It aims to reduce impacts throughout the building’s life.

evidence.quote: U binoning butun hayotiy davri davomida atrof-muhitga ta’sirini kamaytiradigan dizayni, qurilish usullari va materiallarini o‘z ichiga oladi.
evidence.learning_objective: Understand the life-cycle approach to sustainable buildings.

questions.question_uz: Arxitektor va muhandis loyihaning boshidan birga ishlasa, qanday foyda bor?
questions.question_en: What is a benefit of architects and engineers working together from the start?
options_uz: Bino tayyor bo‘lgach, uning vazifasi tanlanadi
Energiya hisobi qurilish tugagunga qadar qoldiriladi
Materiallar faqat tashqi ko‘rinishiga qarab tanlanadi
Barqaror yechimlar dizayn va ishlashga boshidan kiritiladi
options_en: The building’s purpose is chosen after completion
Energy assessment is postponed until construction ends
Materials are selected only for their appearance
Sustainable solutions are built into design and operation from the start
questions.explanation_uz: Erta hamkorlik barqaror yechimlarni binoning dizayni, qurilishi va ishlashiga uyg‘unlashtirishga yordam beradi.
questions.explanation_en: Early collaboration helps integrate sustainable solutions into the building’s design, construction and operation.

evidence.quote: Barqaror arxitektura arxitektor va muhandislarning loyihaning boshlanishidanoq birgalikda ishlashini talab qiladi.
evidence.learning_objective: Explain why integrated design begins early.

questions.question_uz: Maktab binosida mexanik sovitishga ehtiyojni kamaytirish uchun qaysi passiv yechim mos keladi?
questions.question_en: Which passive solution could help a school building rely less on mechanical cooling?
options_uz: Tabiiy shamollatish va soya beruvchi elementlar
Kattaroq elektr generatori va zaxira batareyalar
options_en: Natural ventilation and shading elements
A more powerful air conditioner and extra fans
A larger generator and backup batteries
Extra heaters and automatic thermostats
questions.explanation_uz: Passiv dizayn tabiiy shamollatish va soyalash kabi yechimlardan foydalanadi. Ular mexanik tizimlarga bo‘lgan ehtiyojni kamaytirishga yordam beradi.
questions.explanation_en: Passive design uses features such as natural ventilation and shading. These can reduce reliance on mechanical systems.

evidence.quote: Bunga tabiiy ventilyatsiya, issiqlik massasi va soyali hududlar kiradi
evidence.learning_objective: Apply passive design principles to a school building.

questions.question_uz: Bino loyihasida suv isrofini kamaytirishga qaysi yechim yordam beradi?
questions.question_en: Which building design solution helps reduce water waste?
options_uz: Suv bosimini oshirish va quvurlarni kengaytirish
Yomg‘ir suvini yig‘ish va suvni qayta ishlatish
Shiftni balandlatish va tomni qayta bo‘yash
options_en: Increasing water pressure and widening pipes
Enlarging windows and adding brighter lighting
Collecting rainwater and reusing water
Raising ceilings and repainting the roof
questions.explanation_uz: Maqolada yomg‘ir suvini yig‘ish va ishlatilgan suvni qayta ishlash suvni tejovchi yechimlar sifatida keltirilgan.
questions.explanation_en: The article identifies rainwater collection and water recycling as water-saving solutions.

evidence.quote: Yomg‘ir suvini yig‘ish, loyqa suvni qayta ishlash va samarali sanitariya tizimlari kabi innovatsion muhandislik yechimlari suv isrofini kamaytiradi
evidence.learning_objective: Identify water-saving systems in buildings.

source_title: Suv muammolari va atrof-muhit muhandisligi: barqaror kelajak uchun yangi g'oyalar
title_uz: Suvni asrash uchun qanday yechim tanlaysiz?
title_en: Which solution would you choose to save water?
description_uz: Suv tanqisligi, aqlli kuzatuv, sug‘orish va qayta foydalanish haqida 4 savol.
description_en: Explore water scarcity, smart monitoring, irrigation and reuse in 4 questions.

questions.question_uz: Maqolaga ko‘ra, suv tanqisligini kuchaytiruvchi omillar qaysilar?
questions.question_en: According to the article, which factors make water scarcity worse?
options_uz: Suvni tejash, qayta ishlash va nazorat qilish
Yomg‘ir suvini yig‘ish, saqlash va filtrlash
Ifloslanish, ortiqcha iste’mol va iqlim o‘zgarishi
options_en: Saving, recycling and monitoring water
Collecting, storing and filtering rainwater
Drip irrigation, measurement and planning
Pollution, excessive use and climate change
questions.explanation_uz: Ifloslanish, ortiqcha iste’mol va iqlim o‘zgarishi foydalanish mumkin bo‘lgan toza suv manbalariga bosimni oshiradi.
questions.explanation_en: Pollution, excessive use and climate change put pressure on accessible clean water resources.

evidence.quote: Bu holat ifloslanish, ortiqcha iste’mol va iqlim o‘zgarishi kabi omillar natijasida yuzaga keladi.
evidence.learning_objective: Identify drivers of water scarcity.

questions.question_uz: Suv oqimini doimiy kuzatib, isrofni kamaytirishga qaysi tizim mos?
questions.question_en: Which system is suited to monitoring water flow continuously and reducing waste?
options_uz: Sun’iy intellekt va ulangan qurilmalarga asoslangan tizim
Hisoblagichni oyda bir marta tekshirish tizimi
options_en: A system that stores water in larger tanks
A system using AI and connected devices
A system that checks the meter once a month
A system that treats water with extra filters
questions.explanation_uz: Sun’iy intellekt va IoT qurilmalari suv oqimini kuzatishga yordam beradi. Shu ma’lumotlar asosida isrofgarchilikning oldini olish mumkin.
questions.explanation_en: AI and connected IoT devices help monitor water flow. That information can be used to prevent waste.

evidence.quote: Sun’iy intellekt (AI) va internetga ulangan qurilmalar (IoT) yordamida suv oqimini kuzatish va isrofgarchilikning oldi olinadi.
evidence.learning_objective: Connect smart monitoring with water conservation.

questions.question_uz: Fermer ekinlarni sug‘orishda suvni tejamoqchi. Maqolada tilga olingan qaysi usul mos keladi?
questions.question_en: A farmer wants to save water while irrigating crops. Which method mentioned in the article fits this goal?
options_en: Increasing the flow in irrigation channels
Extending irrigation times
Using drip irrigation
Flooding the entire field
questions.explanation_uz: Tomchilatib sug‘orish maqolada dehqonchilikda suvni tejashga yordam beruvchi usullardan biri sifatida berilgan.
questions.explanation_en: The article presents drip irrigation as a method that helps save water in farming.

evidence.quote: Dehqonchilikda suvni tejash uchun tomchilatib sug‘orish va gidroponika kabi zamonaviy usullar qo‘llaniladi.
evidence.learning_objective: Select a water-saving irrigation method.

questions.question_uz: Ishlatilgan suvdan yana foydalanish uchun qaysi ketma-ketlik to‘g‘ri?
questions.question_en: Which sequence is appropriate for reusing wastewater?
options_uz: Suvni yig‘ish, tozalash, keyin mos maqsadda qayta ishlatish
Suvni yig‘ish, uzoq saqlash, keyin tozalamasdan tarqatish
Suvni yig‘ish, toza suvga aralashtirish, keyin tarqatish
Suvni yig‘ish, yopiq idishga ko‘chirish, keyin tarqatish
options_en: Collect it, treat it, then reuse it for a suitable purpose
Collect it, store it for a long time, then distribute it untreated
Collect it, mix it with clean water, then distribute it
Collect it, move it to a sealed container, then distribute it
questions.explanation_uz: Maqolada ishlatilgan suvlarni tozalab, yana foydalanish imkonini beruvchi tizimlar tasvirlangan. Idishni almashtirish yoki aralashtirish tozalashning o‘rnini bosmaydi.
questions.explanation_en: The article describes systems that treat used water so it can be reused. Changing containers or diluting water does not replace treatment.

evidence.quote: Qishloq xo‘jaligi, sanoat va uy xo‘jaliklaridan chiqqan suvlarni tozalab, yana ishlatish imkonini beruvchi tizimlar yaratiladi.
evidence.learning_objective: Understand treatment as a step in water reuse.

title_en: How does a smart water system work?
description_uz: Sensorlar, suv zaxiralari va tabiatga asoslangan yechimlar bo‘yicha 4 savol.
description_en: Answer 4 questions about sensors, water storage and nature-based solutions.

questions.question_uz: Shahar suv quvurlaridagi sizib chiqishlarni erta aniqlamoqchi. Qaysi vosita eng mos?
questions.question_en: A city wants to detect water pipe leaks early. Which tool is the best fit?
options_uz: IoT kuzatuv qurilmalari va aqlli hisoblagichlar
Kattaroq zaxira idishlari va suv omborlari
Yangi tozalash filtrlari va tindirish hovuzlari
Yomg‘ir yig‘uvchi tomlar va saqlash idishlari
options_en: IoT monitoring devices and smart meters
Larger reserve tanks and reservoirs
New treatment filters and settling ponds
Rain-collecting roofs and storage tanks
questions.explanation_uz: Aqlli suv tizimlari oqimni kuzatish va sizib chiqishlarni aniqlash imkonini beradi. Sensor va hisoblagichlardan kelgan ma’lumotlar bu ishga yordam beradi.
questions.explanation_en: Smart water systems can monitor flow and detect leaks. Data from sensors and meters supports this work.

evidence.quote: Bu tizimlar suv oqimlarini kuzatib borish, qochqinlarni aniqlash va suv sifatini nazorat qilish imkonini beradi.
evidence.learning_objective: Choose monitoring technology to detect leaks.

questions.question_uz: Suv yig‘ish va saqlash tizimlarining asosiy foydasi nima?
questions.question_en: What is a main benefit of water collection and storage systems?
options_uz: Ortiqcha suvni keyin foydalanish uchun saqlash
options_en: Removing salt dissolved in water
Disinfecting wastewater
Saving surplus water for later use
Locating a leak in a water pipe
questions.explanation_uz: Yomg‘ir suvini yig‘ish va yer ostida saqlash kabi usullar ortiqcha suvni keyingi ehtiyojlar uchun zaxiralashga xizmat qiladi.
questions.explanation_en: Methods such as rainwater collection and underground storage preserve surplus water for later needs.

evidence.quote: Bu texnologiyalar ortiqcha suvni kelajakda foydalanish uchun saqlash imkonini beradi.
evidence.learning_objective: Explain the purpose of water storage.

questions.question_uz: Kuchli yomg‘irdan keyingi suv oqimini boshqarish uchun qaysi tabiatga asoslangan yechim mos?
questions.question_en: Which nature-based solution is suitable for managing runoff after heavy rain?
options_uz: Maydonni suv o‘tkazmaydigan qoplama bilan yopish
Yashil tomlar va suv o‘tkazuvchan qoplamalar yaratish
options_en: Covering the area with an impermeable surface
Reducing the size of rainwater collection areas
Replacing planted areas with concrete
Creating green roofs and permeable surfaces
questions.explanation_uz: Maqola yashil tomlar va suv o‘tkazuvchan qoplamalarni yomg‘ir oqimini boshqarishga yordam beruvchi yechimlar qatorida sanaydi.
questions.explanation_en: The article lists green roofs and permeable surfaces among solutions that help manage stormwater.

evidence.quote: suv o'tkazuvchan qoplamalar, yashil tomlar va bioswales kabi infratuzilmalar bo‘ron suvini boshqarish
evidence.learning_objective: Apply nature-based approaches to stormwater management.

questions.question_uz: Maqoladagi aqlli kanalizatsiya misolida sun’iy intellekt sensor ma’lumotlaridan nima uchun foydalanadi?
questions.question_en: In the article’s smart sewer example, what does AI use sensor data for?
options_uz: Suv tarkibidagi tuzlarni bevosita ajratish uchun
Turli ob-havoda tizim ishlashini bashorat qilish uchun
Suv oqimini sensor o‘rniga bevosita o‘lchash uchun
Oqova suvni quvurlardan jismonan haydash uchun
options_en: To separate dissolved salts directly from the water
To predict system performance in different weather
To directly measure flow instead of a sensor
To physically pump wastewater through the pipes
questions.explanation_uz: Sensorlar suv oqimi va chuqurligini o‘lchaydi. Sun’iy intellekt shu ma’lumotlarni tahlil qilib, turli ob-havoda kanalizatsiya qanday ishlashini bashorat qiladi.
questions.explanation_en: Sensors measure water flow and depth. AI analyses those measurements to predict how the sewer system will perform in different weather.

evidence.quote: Sun’iy intellekt (AI) esa turli ob-havo sharoitlarida kanalizatsiya tizimining ishlashini oldindan bashorat qilish uchun sensorlardan olingan ma’lumotlarni tahlil qiladi.
evidence.learning_objective: Distinguish sensor measurement from AI prediction.

source_title: Chiqindidan xazinaga: muhandislik aylana chiqindilari tizimlari
description_uz: Buyumlarni uzoqroq ishlatish, aqlli kuzatuv va chiqindidan energiya olish haqida 4 savol.
description_en: Explore longer-lasting products, smart monitoring and energy from waste in 4 questions.

questions.question_uz: Qaysi qaror aylana iqtisodiyot g‘oyasiga mos keladi?
questions.question_en: Which decision fits the idea of a circular economy?
options_uz: Buyumni ta’mirlash, qayta ishlatish yoki qayta ishlash
Ishlaydigan jihozni har yili yangisiga almashtirish
options_en: Repairing, reusing or recycling a product
Making product packaging thicker
Replacing working equipment every year
Making a product cheaper so it can be discarded sooner
questions.explanation_uz: Aylana iqtisodiyot buyumlarning uzoqroq xizmat qilishi va resurslarning qayta ishlatilishiga intiladi. Ta’mirlash va qayta foydalanish shu yondashuvga mos.
questions.explanation_en: A circular economy aims to keep products useful for longer and reuse resources. Repair and reuse support that approach.

evidence.quote: har bir mahsulot uzoqroq xizmat qilishi, yana foydalanilishi yoki qayta ishlanishini ta’minlaydi.
evidence.learning_objective: Apply circular economy principles to a product decision.

questions.question_uz: Maqolada IoT qurilmalarining aylana iqtisodiyotdagi asosiy vazifasi qanday tushuntirilgan?
questions.question_en: How does the article describe the main role of IoT devices in a circular economy?
options_uz: Mahsulotga oid yozuvlarni o‘zgarmas zanjirda saqlaydi
Tayyor ma’lumotlardan nosozlik vaqtini bashorat qiladi
Sensorlar orqali ma’lumot yig‘adi va ulashadi
options_en: They store product records in an unalterable chain
They predict failure timing from existing data
They remove worn components and install replacements
They collect and share data through sensors
questions.explanation_uz: IoT qurilmalari sensorlar va aloqa vositalari orqali ma’lumot yig‘adi, saqlaydi va ulashadi. Bu ma’lumot keyingi tahlilga asos bo‘ladi.
questions.explanation_en: IoT devices collect, store and share data using sensors and communication systems. The data provides a basis for further analysis.

evidence.quote: sensorlar, aloqa protokollari va ma’lumotlar bazalari orqali ma’lumot yig‘ish, saqlash va ulashishiga imkon beradi.
evidence.learning_objective: Identify the information-gathering role of IoT.

questions.question_uz: Kir yuvish mashinasi sensori detal eskirayotganini ko‘rsatdi. Chiqindini kamaytirish uchun qaysi harakat ma’qul?
questions.question_en: A washing machine sensor shows that a component is wearing out. Which action best supports reducing waste?
options_uz: Mashina ishlayotgan bo‘lsa ham uni tashlash
options_en: Discarding the machine while it still works
Repairing the affected component before failure
Replacing only the machine’s outer casing
Deleting the readings and waiting for failure
questions.explanation_uz: Ma’lumotlar tahlili muammolarni oldindan ko‘rishga yordam beradi. Shunda mahsulotni buzilishidan oldin ta’mirlab, foydalanishda davom etish mumkin.
questions.explanation_en: Data analysis can help identify problems in advance. This makes it possible to repair a product before it fails and keep using it.

evidence.quote: mahsulotlar hali buzilmasdan avval ta’mirlab bo‘lishi mumkin.
evidence.learning_objective: Apply predictive maintenance to extend product life.

questions.question_uz: Blue Plains misolida biogazdan nima ishlab chiqariladi?
questions.question_en: In the Blue Plains example, what is produced using biogas?
options_en: Drinking water
A metal alloy
Electrical energy
Glass products
questions.explanation_uz: Maqoladagi inshoot biogazdan elektr energiyasi oladi. Bu chiqindini foydali resursga aylantirishga misol.
questions.explanation_en: The facility described in the article generates electricity from biogas. This is an example of turning waste into a useful resource.

evidence.quote: jarayonda hosil bo‘ladigan biogaz elektr energiyasiga aylantirilib
evidence.learning_objective: Recognise energy recovery from waste-derived biogas.

source_title: Uglerodni tutib olish va saqlash: Muhandislar iqlim o‘zgarishini jilovlay oladimi?
title_en: From capturing CO₂ to storing it
description_uz: Uglerodni tutib olish bosqichlari, usullari va xavfsiz saqlash haqida 4 savol.
description_en: Answer 4 questions about carbon capture stages, methods and safe storage.

questions.question_uz: CCS jarayonining bosqichlari qaysi tartibda bajariladi?
questions.question_en: In which order do the stages of CCS take place?
options_uz: CO₂ ni tashish, saqlash, keyin tutib olish
CO₂ ni tashish, tutib olish, keyin saqlash
CO₂ ni saqlash, tutib olish, keyin tashish
CO₂ ni tutib olish, tashish, keyin saqlash
options_en: Transport CO₂, store it, then capture it
Transport CO₂, capture it, then store it
Store CO₂, capture it, then transport it
Capture CO₂, transport it, then store it
questions.explanation_uz: Avval CO₂ boshqa gazlardan ajratib olinadi, keyin saqlash joyiga tashiladi. Oxirida u chuqur yer osti qatlamlariga yuboriladi.
questions.explanation_en: First, CO₂ is separated from other gases and then transported to a storage site. Finally, it is injected into deep underground formations.

evidence.quote: CO₂ ni tutib olish, uni tashish va yer ostida chuqur qatlamlarda uzoq muddatga saqlash.
evidence.learning_objective: Order the three stages of carbon capture and storage.

questions.question_uz: Yonishdan keyingi tutib olish usulida CO₂ qayerdan ajratib olinadi?
questions.question_en: In post-combustion capture, where is CO₂ separated from?
options_en: Clean water in the cooling system
The solid part of unburned fuel
Exhaust gases produced after fuel burns
Underground mineral formations
questions.explanation_uz: Yonishdan keyingi usulda CO₂ yoqilg‘i yonishi natijasida hosil bo‘lgan chiqindi gazlar tarkibidan ajratiladi.
questions.explanation_en: Post-combustion capture separates CO₂ from the exhaust gases produced by burning fuel.

evidence.quote: Bunda CO₂ yoqilg‘i yonishi natijasida hosil bo‘lgan chiqindi gazlardan ajratib olinadi.
evidence.learning_objective: Identify the gas stream used in post-combustion capture.

questions.question_uz: Kislorod muhitida yoqish usulida oddiy havo o‘rniga nima ishlatiladi?
questions.question_en: What is used instead of ordinary air in oxy-fuel combustion?
options_en: Cooled water vapour
Nearly pure oxygen
Compressed nitrogen
Purified biogas
questions.explanation_uz: Bu usulda yoqilg‘i deyarli sof kislorodda yoqiladi. Hosil bo‘lgan gazda CO₂ ulushi yuqori bo‘lib, uni ajratish osonlashadi.
questions.explanation_en: The fuel is burned in nearly pure oxygen. The resulting gas has a higher concentration of CO₂, making separation easier.

evidence.quote: yoqilg‘i oddiy havo o‘rniga deyarli sof kislorod muhitida yoqiladi.
evidence.learning_objective: Understand the distinguishing feature of oxy-fuel combustion.

questions.question_uz: CO₂ yer ostiga yuborilgandan keyin nega uzoq muddat kuzatuv kerak?
questions.question_en: Why is long-term monitoring needed after CO₂ is stored underground?
options_uz: CO₂ sizib chiqmayotganini nazorat qilish uchun
Gazni tashigan kemalarning yo‘nalishini tanlash uchun
Saqlash uchun sarflangan qurilish materiallarini hisoblash uchun
Gazni ajratishdan oldingi yoqilg‘i turini tanlash uchun
options_en: To check that the CO₂ is not leaking
To select routes for ships that transported the gas
To count the construction materials used at the storage site
To select the fuel type before the gas was captured
questions.explanation_uz: Sizib chiqish saqlashning foydasini kamaytirishi va atrof-muhitga zarar yetkazishi mumkin. Shuning uchun saqlash joyining xavfsizligi uzoq muddat nazorat qilinadi.
questions.explanation_en: Leakage could reduce the benefits of storage and harm the environment. Storage safety therefore needs long-term monitoring.

evidence.quote: saqlangan CO₂ sizib chiqmasligini ta’minlash uchun uzoq muddatli monitoringni talab etadi.
evidence.learning_objective: Explain why geological CO₂ storage needs monitoring.

source_title: Suv Tanqisligiga Qarshi Texnologik Yondashuv: Yomg‘ir Suvini Qayta Ishlatish
description_uz: Yomg‘ir suvini yig‘ish, ishlatish va xavfsiz tizim loyihalash haqida 4 savol.
description_en: Explore rainwater collection, reuse and safe system design in 4 questions.

questions.question_uz: Shahar sharoitida yomg‘ir suvini yig‘ish tizimi suvni odatda qayerdan oladi?
questions.question_en: Where does an urban rainwater collection system usually gather water from?
options_uz: Tomlar, ayvonlar va hovlilardan oqib tushgan yomg‘irdan
options_en: Only from deep underground wells
From the main pipes of the drinking water network
From rain running off roofs, terraces and courtyards
From industrial wastewater streams
questions.explanation_uz: Maqolada shahar tizimlari tomlar, ayvonlar, hovlilar va boshqa suv o‘tkazmaydigan yuzalardan oqib tushgan suvni yig‘ishi tushuntiriladi.
questions.explanation_en: The article explains that urban systems collect runoff from roofs, terraces, courtyards and other impermeable surfaces.

evidence.quote: tomlar, ayvonlar, hovlilar va boshqa suv o‘tkazmaydigan yuzalardan oqib tushadigan suvlarni
evidence.learning_objective: Identify urban rainwater collection surfaces.

questions.question_uz: Maqolada yig‘ilgan yomg‘ir suvidan foydalanishning qaysi yo‘li ko‘rsatilgan?
questions.question_en: Which use of collected rainwater is described in the article?
options_en: Preparing drinks without filtration
Watering gardens and household cleaning
Using it directly in food production
Adding it untreated to the public drinking water supply
questions.explanation_uz: Yig‘ilgan yomg‘ir suvi bog‘dorchilik va tozalash kabi ehtiyojlarga sarflanishi mumkin. Tizimni foydalanish maqsadiga mos va xavfsiz qilish muhim.
questions.explanation_en: Collected rainwater can serve needs such as gardening and cleaning. The system should be designed to be safe and suitable for its intended use.

evidence.quote: Zaxiralangan suv asosan hojatxona, kir yuvish, bog’dorchilik maqsadlarida va tozalash kabi uy ho’jalik maqsadlarida foydalaniladi.
evidence.learning_objective: Identify suitable non-drinking uses described in the article.

questions.question_uz: Maktab tomiga qancha yomg‘ir suvi tushishini dastlab hisoblash uchun qaysi ikki ma’lumot kerak?
questions.question_en: Which two inputs are needed for an initial estimate of how much rain falls onto a school roof?
options_uz: Yog‘ingarchilik miqdori va suv yig‘uvchi tom maydoni
Nasos quvvati va filtrning o‘tkazish tezligi
Quvurlarning narxi va yetkazib berish muddati
options_en: Rainfall amounts and the roof collection area
The building’s floors and the layout of its rooms
Pump power and the filter’s flow capacity
Pipe prices and delivery times
questions.explanation_uz: Yog‘ingarchilik miqdori va tom maydoni tomga tushishi mumkin bo‘lgan suv hajmini baholashga yordam beradi. Muhandislar bu ma’lumotlardan yig‘ish va zaxiralash tizimini rejalashda foydalanadi.
questions.explanation_en: Rainfall amounts and roof area help estimate the volume of rain falling on the roof. Engineers use these inputs when planning collection and storage systems.

evidence.quote: Yog’ingarchilik miqdori siklini va tomdagi suv yig‘ish maydonlarini tahlil qilishdan
evidence.learning_objective: Select rainfall and collection area as inputs for an initial roof-water estimate.

questions.question_uz: Yig‘ilgan suv bilan bog‘ni sug‘orishdan oldin tozalash qurilmasining vazifasi nima?
questions.question_en: What is the role of treatment equipment before collected water is used to irrigate a garden?
options_en: Setting the garden’s irrigation schedule
Storing water until the next rainfall
Directing roof runoff into the tank
Reducing contaminants in the water
questions.explanation_uz: Tozalash qurilmalari yig‘ilgan suvdagi ifloslantiruvchi moddalarni tozalash uchun loyihalanadi. Bu suvdan xavfsiz foydalanishga yordam beradi.
questions.explanation_en: Treatment equipment is designed to remove contaminants from collected water. This supports safer use of the water.

evidence.quote: yig’ilgan suvdan ifloslantiruvchi moddalarni tozalashga mo’ljallangan tozalash qurilmalarini
evidence.learning_objective: Explain the purpose of treating collected rainwater.
